scope: Proposition 4.3 of the manuscript “A Smooth Nonquadratic Entire Affine Maximal Graph in Dimension Ten” (preprints/Smooth-Nonquadratic-Affine-Maximal-Graph-in-Dimension-Ten-October-5-2026/affine-maximal-dimension-ten.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 353 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f7851c8489621a2d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The solution in Lemma 3.1 extends to every r > 0, with F, P, y, y′ > 0. Its radial extensions to R9 are smooth, and D2 xF is positive definite everywhere.
